name: agentcourier
description: Shows when another AI agent sends a message to this window's Copilot via agentcourier.

commands.title: agentcourier: Show new messages in Copilot Chat

agentcourier.path.description: Path to the agentcourier program. Empty: ~/.cargo/bin/agentcourier, then PATH.

agentcourier.autoRead.description: When a message arrives for this window, ask Copilot to read it right away (a fixed request; the message text is never typed into the chat). Off: show a notice with a button instead.
